source: Municipal VBZ performed-service endpoints, Fahrzeiten_SOLL_IST_20230723_20230729.csv, cached on jtl110gpu2. Filter 07:30–09:35 before transferring. Reuse the existing calendar, station aliases and planned-minute matching rules.
population: V22's four named OD pairs and six readiness clocks, 40-minute journey horizon. Enumerate single-vehicle incoming prefixes of the scheduled itinerary up to its first transfer. Examine the original destination and all downstream destinations reachable by two distinct scheduled through vehicles from that platform. Deduplicate by incoming prefix, destination and pair, keeping the first declared window. Both paths and the incoming trip must be distinct. Choose one pair per prefix/destination using public schedules and the July 25 fit only. Keep primary named OD and expanded destinations visible in the output.
screen: Allow planned first departures from 120 seconds before to 600 seconds after scheduled platform readiness. Rank eligible pairs by closest planned destination arrival, then earliest latest departure, then connection IDs. Under the July 25 model require one common supported incoming clock at which each option has positive legal departure mass and both strict nominal option rankings across the possible incoming clocks. Freeze selected paths before evaluating any July 23/24 actual receipts.
clock: Common 30-second publication delay after start or receipt, in parallel with GTFS conservative station transfer minimum (default 120 seconds). Local departure nonoccurrence starts at actual incoming arrival, so earlier departures stay in the unobserved mass. Decisions use only receipts available by that clock. Departures with missing measurements stay unresolved. A known departure before platform entry is not exposed to the policy.
comparison: Compare first legal offer from the two paths, compiled nominal mean-clock board-or-wait, and conditional same-trip board-or-wait. One can reject an offer for the other still-possible vehicle; use zero margin, prefer boarding on ties. Nominal and conditional share the fitted law, departure survival, paths, deadline and receipts. Reuse the integrated 60/20/10-second reference and record each resolution. Report incoming receipt ranking reversals under the nominal prior as a mechanism diagnostic. Independently report whether both actual options could have been boarded at entry; this uses retrospective data and is not a policy input or a filter for the primary mean. If the published offer clock is outside the integrated score support, use the nominal action and record the fallback.
endpoints: Pair outcome, arrival, action changes, losses for all comparable cases and cases with genuinely competing offers, day-level frequency, plus shared preparation and separate policy costs. Record no offer, prefix failure, unmeasured endpoints and scoring outside support. Use individual windows descriptively; two dates cannot establish a population confidence bound.
research_gate: Start a new method/certificate only if natural causal improvements over both first offer and matched nominal occur beyond isolated events, repeat across dates and plausibly justify charged cost. Preserve V20's frozen original-policy result. Do not treat a synthetic witness or a retrospective gap as a passed G2.
normal_control: If no ranked pair at a prefix/destination changes order across supported incoming clocks, retain the first ranked pair with shared positive legal departure mass as a descriptive normal control. Keep it outside the reversal cohort.
